properties.notes: Site is identified as a Development Opportunity Area in the adopted Fareham Local Plan Part 2 (2015) and identified as a proposed Fareham Town Centre housing allocation in the Draft Local Plan (2017). This identifies a capacity of 120 dwellings for the site. Immediate and surrounding uses include a public transport hub and interchange, low-key industrial service industries, fire station and some residential. Relocation of existing fire station or incorporation into a redevelopment would be required.. https://www.fareham.gov.uk/planning/publicationplanevidence.aspx
